scope: The seven methods of tests/test_static_tray_readback_v01.py within the complete default inventory, on the owner's prepared macOS arm64 environment

node.trust_anchor: this adopted pin; a signature check by a Node.js release key is optional additional evidence and is recorded either way
node.retrieval: a separately selected preparation phase, after the owner's approval of the download (about 53 MB)
node.executable_pin: SHA-256, size and mode recorded at preparation and frozen in the reviewed execution plan before any start
node.destination: an absent task-specific directory; never replaces another executable

python.interpreter: the C271 worktree's own .venv, created in place from main's committed local environment specification
python.comparison: names and versions, as the provider and probe compare them today

dependencies.kinds: JavaScript, JSON or text; no native module

read_roots: cohort root holding the bound manifest, jobs, inputs and stage
write_roots: the private stage of that start

facts: Permission Model stability 2, Stable; enabled by --permission
spawning a child without --allow-child-process throws ERR_ACCESS_DENIED
limits: symbolic links are followed outside granted paths; existing file descriptors bypass the model

mitigations: no symlink in the dependency tree or the stage (existing refusal)
the child receives only its three standard streams

supervisor.reimplemented: run_process, with the original signature and receipt fields
supervisor.only_change: the Linux precondition prctl(PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER) is replaced by: sys.platform == 'darwin', machine arm64, not translated
supervisor.original_supervisor: byte-identical; stays the Linux contract's supervisor

kept: one direct child in its own session and process group
bounded capture, deadlines, no retry, receipts, handles closed
a live member of the child's process group after exit refuses the run
SIGTERM then SIGKILL of the group within 2,000 ms
not_kept: orphaned descendants re-parented to and reaped by the supervisor (Darwin re-parents them to launchd)
added: a Node checker creates no descendant: enforced by the permission model

preparer.publication: renamex_np(staged, destination, RENAME_EXCL) from libSystem on the same APFS volume
preparer.flag_binding: the implementation binds RENAME_EXCL's value from the SDK header or Apple's documentation and proves no-replace with control MC15

fields: Python executable, version, build, seven package versions, lock bytes
Node executable path, type, SHA-256, size, mode; archive pin
mach_o_rules: LC_LOAD_DYLIB, LC_LOAD_WEAK_DYLIB and LC_REEXPORT_DYLIB under /usr/lib/ or /System/Library/

M1.command: node --version under the permission flags, through the Darwin supervisor
M1.optional: one codesign --verify --strict inspection start, counted separately; not required

host_observation.closure_claim: The Node executable's bytes and load commands are bound; the system libraries it loads come from the OS build's dyld shared cache and are identified only by the recorded OS product version and build, not by per-file hashes.

selection_rule.qualifying_run: driver receives --readback-config and --readback-config-sha256 from an independently reviewed execution plan; all existing rules apply; any skip, error, expected failure or missing method of the readback cohort fails the run; only a qualifying run can be cited for the readback methods, Gate H or R03
selection_rule.ordinary_run: no selection: the driver proceeds and records readback_selection {status: absent, run_kind: ordinary}; the CPU class skips its three methods with the fixed reason 'No approved current-host readback selection: ordinary run, not a qualification'; coordinator seams run; no ordinary run is evidence for the readback methods
selection_rule.amends: P05 CONTRACT.json selection.absent_behavior, for ordinary runs only
selection_rule.rejected_alternative: requiring a selection for every run, which would make main's ordinary routine refuse to start on any uncommitted change after R04

substitutions.S1: Node build: official v24.22.1 darwin-arm64 release instead of the Codex runtime's Linux build
substitutions.S2: qualification Python: the worktree .venv with main's macOS lock instead of the Codex runtime's CPython 3.12.14 and the linux-cp312 lock
substitutions.S3: host observation: M0 and M1 instead of the ELF closure, ldd and /0.1.1-/0.1.5 plans
substitutions.S4: process supervisor: Darwin variant without the child-subreaper precondition
substitutions.S5: Node launch flags: --permission with exact read and write grants added before --no-addons and --max-old-space-size=256
substitutions.S6: preparer: macOS no-replace rename and one-member extraction instead of renameat2 and Linux-only installation
substitutions.S7: host bindings of provider and probe: Darwin platform, build, translation, kern.bootsessionuuid, Mach-O binding, S1 pins, macOS lock
substitutions.S8: selection rule: absent selection is an ordinary run; qualifying runs keep every rule
